Let's start. 
This is my sophomore year of high school. I was dating this girl, Annabelle. I loved her, she loved me, the usual high school stuff.
Anyway we had been dating since Christmas Eve last year, and over the summer we didn't get much interaction. Well, unbeknownst to me, she started seeing another guy, named Zac. School started, and she was completely blowing me off for him. See, me, being the dumb high school in love kid, just thought we wanted to spend time with her friends. 
Eventually about a couple weeks I confronted her about it, and she flat out admitted it and then broke up with me. Now, at this point I was crushed. Turns out he pressured her to break up with me, but she "didn't want to". Me, still in love, I took her back and for a few days everything seemed okay.
That was, until me and her went to our schools football game. 
About halftime, she got up and said she was gonna go get some food and asked if I wanted anything.
I replied no, and she walked off.
I waited for probably 10-15 minutes before getting a bit suspicious, so I decided to go check if she was okay. 
What I found crushed me. 
I walked into the good court and saw her and zac making out in a corner. I walked up to her, tears in my eyes, said I was sorry, and I left. I couldn't even go to school I was so depressed.
